# MMPX reference vectors (u6-render hd tests): synthetic images, run through the MMPX
# reference C++ of McGuire & Gagiu 2021 (MIT; the JCGT supplement's cppPerf.cpp
# MMPXAlgorithm, clamp-to-border sampling), x4 = the reference twice. Per case: its name,
# width, height and scale; its palette (packed little-endian RGBA words, alpha in the top
# byte); the input as palette indices (0-9 a-z), then '=' and the output likewise.
